examples.title: Choose a traversal of a complete input tree
examples.explanationHtml: The tree is built without sorting. Mode 1 visits the left subtree, root, and right subtree, in that order.

examples.title: Walk inorder without recursive calls
examples.explanationHtml: The explicit stack remembers ancestors waiting for their visit. Each pointer is pushed and popped once.

examples.title: Reconstruct from preorder and inorder
examples.explanationHtml: Preorder selects 8 as the root. Its inorder position splits off the left subtree; the reconstructed postorder ends with 8.

practice.title: Reverse level order
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12) and complete-tree keys (-99..99). After the prompt Count and keys:, print reverse: and the exact reverse of left-first level order.
hints: Keep the original left/right links unchanged.

practice.title: Compare inorder methods
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12) and complete-tree keys (-99..99). After the prompt Count and keys:, print recursive: and iterative: inorder lines.
hints: Keep the original left/right links unchanged.

practice.title: Print nodes at a depth
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12) and complete-tree keys (-99..99). After the prompt Count and keys:, then read depth d (0..12); print depth: and its keys from left to right.
hints: Keep the original left/right links unchanged.

practice.title: Validate reconstruction
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12), n preorder int keys, then n distinct inorder int keys. Print Count, preorder, inorder (distinct keys): then postorder: with keys, or Invalid traversals.
hints: Reject a root missing from its current inorder interval.

quiz.prompt: Which traversal should free children before a parent?
quiz.explanation: Postorder performs the root action after both child calls return.

quiz.prompt: Which structure selects the next node in level order?
quiz.explanation: A queue processes earlier levels before later ones.

quiz.prompt: What extra condition makes preorder plus inorder reconstruction unambiguous?
quiz.explanation: A unique root position in each inorder interval determines the split.

quiz.prompt: Why is inorder not always sorted for an arbitrary binary tree?
options: Its shape need not obey BST ordering
quiz.explanation: Inorder gives sorted keys only when the BST property holds.

quiz.prompt: What does the iterative inorder stack remember?
options: Ancestors whose root visit is still pending
quiz.explanation: The left descent delays ancestor visits until the left subtree finishes.

quiz.prompt: How many node visits does preorder make for n nodes?
quiz.explanation: Each non-NULL node causes exactly one visit action.

quiz.prompt: Which preorder element identifies the reconstructed root?
options: The first element in the current subtree sequence
quiz.explanation: Preorder visits a subtree root before either child subtree.

quiz.prompt: The root has key 8, with leaves 3 and 10. Which preorder does this function print?
quiz.explanation: Preorder visits 8 before its left leaf 3 and right leaf 10.

quiz.prompt: The recursive visit lies between child calls. Which order results for keys 8, 3 and 10?
quiz.explanation: Inorder places the root between left and right visits.

quiz.prompt: The visit follows both recursive calls. Which node finishes last?
quiz.explanation: Postorder finishes the left leaf, right leaf, then root 8.

quiz.prompt: What is the worst-case time of reconstruction with a fresh linear inorder search for each root?
quiz.explanation: An end-root split can scan nearly n keys, then n-1, and so on.

keyPoints.en: Preorder visits the root before either subtree.
keyPoints.bn: প্রিঅর্ডারে সাবট্রি দেখার আগে রুট দেখো।

keyPoints.en: Inorder visits left, root and right.
keyPoints.bn: ইনঅর্ডারে আগে বাম, তারপর রুট, শেষে ডান সাবট্রি দেখো।

keyPoints.en: Postorder finishes children before their parent.
keyPoints.bn: পোস্টঅর্ডারে চাইল্ডগুলোর কাজ শেষে প্যারেন্টে আসো।
লেভেল অর্ডারে কিউ দিয়ে এক লেভেলের পর আরেক লেভেল দেখো।

keyPoints.en: Iterative inorder keeps waiting ancestors on a stack.
keyPoints.bn: ইটারেটিভ ইনঅর্ডারে অপেক্ষায় থাকা নোডগুলো স্ট্যাকে রাখো।

keyPoints.en: Distinct keys let preorder and inorder identify one tree.
keyPoints.bn: কীগুলো আলাদা হলে প্রিঅর্ডার আর ইনঅর্ডার দিয়ে নির্দিষ্ট একটা ট্রি বানানো যায়।

examQuestions.question: For root 8 with left child 3 and right child 10, where 3 has children 1 and 6, list preorder, inorder, postorder and level order.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Preorder: 8,3,1,6,10. Inorder: 1,3,6,8,10. Postorder: 1,6,3,10,8. Level order: 8,3,10,1,6. Depth-first orders place the root before, between or after its child traversals; the queue order completes one depth first.

examQuestions.question: Reconstruct the tree from preorder 8,3,1,6,10 and inorder 1,3,6,8,10. Show the splits.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Root 8 splits inorder into [1,3,6] and [10]. The next preorder root 3 splits its left interval into [1] and [6]. Thus 8.left=3, 8.right=10, 3.left=1 and 3.right=6. Leaves have two missing children. Distinct keys make each split unique.

examQuestions.question: Explain the iterative inorder stack invariant and give its cost.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Push each ancestor while descending left. A stack entry is a node whose own visit is waiting for its left subtree to finish. When cur becomes NULL, pop and visit one node, then descend from its right child. Continue while cur exists or the stack is nonempty. Every node is pushed and popped once, giving O(n) time and O(h+1) live stack space.

examQuestions.question: Why can level order need more working memory than recursive preorder on the same tree?
examQuestions.answerHtml: A perfect tree has height logarithmic in n but about half its nodes at the final level. Recursive preorder retains one path, using O(log n) calls. A level-order queue can retain a broad frontier of O(n) nodes.

summary.en: Visit nodes in four orders and reconstruct a distinct-key tree from two traversals.
summary.bn: চারভাবে ট্রির নোডগুলো দেখো, আর দুটো ট্রাভার্সাল থেকে আলাদা কী-র ট্রি আবার বানাও।
